paras: Darevskia dahli is a species of lizard in the family Lacertidae. The species is native to Eastern Europe and Western Asia.
The specific name, dahli, is in honor of Russian zoologist Sergei Konstantinovich Dahl.
D. dahli is found in Armenia, Georgia, and Ukraine.
The preferred natural habitats of D. dahli are forest and rocky areas, at altitudes of 900–1,700 m (3,000–5,600 ft).
D. dahli is oviparous and parthenogenetic. An adult female may lay a clutch of 2–5 eggs.
